mapper.sql: s.id skillId,s.account_id accountId,s.visibility,s.name,s.description,s.status,s.revision, s.skill_type skillType,s.tool_name toolName,s.instructions,s.context_requirements contextRequirements, s.tool_url toolUrl,s.http_method httpMethod,s.input_schema inputSchema,s.output_schema outputSchema, s.tool_secret_id toolSecretId,s.requires_user_credential requiresUserCredential, s.identity_binding identityBinding,s.frontend_fields frontendFields,s.timeout_ms timeoutMs, s.max_result_bytes maxResultBytes,s.max_calls_per_session maxCallsPerSession,s.import_format importFormat, s.created_at createdAt,s.updated_at updatedAt,sec.display_suffix tokenSuffix
mapper.select: select 1 from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.status!='DELETED' and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.visibility='PRIVATE' order by s.visibility,s.created_at desc,s.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_skill where status!='DELETED' and account_id=#{accountId} and visibility='PRIVATE'

select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.status!='DELETED' and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.visibility='OFFICIAL' order by s.created_at desc,s.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_skill where status!='DELETED' and account_id=#{accountId} and visibility='OFFICIAL'
select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.status='PUBLISHED' and (s.account_id=#{accountId} or s.visibility='OFFICIAL') order by s.visibility desc,s.name,s.id
select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.id=#{skillId} and s.status!='DELETED' and (s.account_id=#{accountId} or s.visibility='OFFICIAL')
select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.id=#{skillId} and s.status!='DELETED' and s.account_id=#{accountId} and s.visibility='OFFICIAL'
select from p_skill s left join p_secret sec on sec.id=s.tool_secret_id where s.id=#{skillId} and s.account_id=#{accountId}

select (select count(*) from p_application_skill where skill_id=#{skillId}) + (select count(*) from p_resource_reference where resource_type='SKILL' and resource_id=#{skillId} and state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED'))

select count(*) from p_resource_reference r join p_application a on a.id=#{applicationId} and a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.admin_disabled=0 join p_skill s on s.id=r.resource_id and s.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') where r.account_id=#{accountId} and r.holder_type='SESSION' and r.holder_id=#{sessionId} and r.resource_type='SKILL' and r.resource_id=#{skillId} and r.state='CONFIRMED'
select request_hash requestHash,resource_id resourceId,status from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into p_skill (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,visibility,name,description,status,revision,skill_type,tool_name, instructions,context_requirements,tool_url,http_method,input_schema,output_schema,tool_secret_id, requires_user_credential,identity_binding,frontend_fields,timeout_ms,max_result_bytes,max_calls_per_session, import_format,content_hash) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{visibility},#{name},#{description},'PUBLISHED',1, #{skillType},#{toolName},#{instructions},cast(#{context} as json),#{toolUrl},#{httpMethod}, cast(#{inputSchema} as json),cast(#{outputSchema} as json),#{secretId},#{userCredential}, cast(#{identityBinding} as json),cast(#{frontendFields} as json),#{timeoutMs},#{maxResultBytes}, #{maxCallsPerSession},#{importFormat},#{hash})
mapper.update: update p_skill set name=#{name},description=#{description},skill_type=#{skillType}, tool_name=#{toolName},instructions=#{instructions},context_requirements=cast(#{context} as json), tool_url=#{toolUrl},http_method=#{httpMethod},input_schema=cast(#{inputSchema} as json), output_schema=cast(#{outputSchema} as json),tool_secret_id=#{secretId}, requires_user_credential=#{userCredential},identity_binding=cast(#{identityBinding} as json), frontend_fields=cast(#{frontendFields} as json),timeout_ms=#{timeoutMs},max_result_bytes=#{maxResultBytes}, max_calls_per_session=#{maxCallsPerSession},import_format=#{importFormat},content_hash=#{hash}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{skillId} and account_id=#{accountId} and visibility=#{visibility} and revision=#{revision} and status not in ('DISABLED','DELETED')

update p_skill set status=#{status},revision=revision+1, deleted_at=case when #{status}='DELETED' then utc_timestamp(3) else deleted_at end, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{skillId} and account_id=#{accountId} and visibility=#{visibility} and revision=#{revision} and status!='DELETED'
mapper.select: select id,ciphertext,nonce,auth_tag,key_version,algorithm,status from p_secret where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='TOOL_ACCESS' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update p_secret set status='DELETED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{secretId} and purpose='TOOL_ACCESS' and status!='DELETED'

update p_secret sec join p_skill s on s.tool_secret_id=sec.id set sec.status='DELETED',sec.revision=sec.revision+1,sec.updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where s.id=#{skillId} and sec.purpose='TOOL_ACCESS' and sec.status!='DELETED'
